projects.title: Canadian Defence Hardware Program
projects.description: Eleven hands-on hardware builds across sky, water, and ground, each mapped to a stated Defence Drone Initiative or Army MINERVA requirement - full BOMs, prices, step-by-step build guides, and bench photos.

projects.title: Sky: Passive Aerial Early-Warning Node
projects.description: Receive-only passive radar on a KrakenSDR 5-channel coherent SDR: FM/TV broadcast reflections off aircraft, range-Doppler processing with pyAPRiL, scored against an RTL-SDR ADS-B ground-truth receiver.

projects.title: Water: Passive Acoustic Vessel Monitor
projects.description: Solar-powered hydrophone node classifying passing vessels from underwater sound, with an RTL-SDR AIS receiver as ground truth and a dock-to-recharge extension.

projects.title: Ground: Seismic & Acoustic Perimeter Mesh
projects.description: Solar 915 MHz LoRa mesh of ESP32 nodes with ADXL355 accelerometers and geophones, classifying vehicles vs footsteps vs wind at the edge and reporting signed detections.

projects.title: GPS-Denied Navigation Rover
projects.description: ROS 2 rover fusing wheel odometry, BNO085 IMU, and 2D LiDAR with an Extended Kalman Filter; GNSS gets switched off and position drift is measured against a u-blox ground-truth track.

projects.title: Convoy-Following Robots on a Degraded Mesh
projects.description: Two rovers convoy behind a lead vehicle over a 915 MHz LoRa / Wi-Fi mesh, hold formation through induced link drops, and recover on reconnect - the resupply-convoy DDIL problem at bench scale.

projects.title: Passive Acoustic Drone Detector
projects.description: MEMS microphone array on a Raspberry Pi detecting rotor harmonics, rejecting birds and aircraft, and estimating direction of arrival by beamforming - emits nothing, only detects.

projects.title: Thermal Search-and-Rescue Drone
projects.description: X500-class quadcopter with a FLIR Lepton thermal camera and Hailo AI HAT+ edge detection finding people in snow and brush, pushing georeferenced detections to a live map.

projects.title: Cold-Soak Battery Characterization Rig
projects.description: Heated, instrumented drone battery bay tested in a lab freezer and real Canadian winter - runtime, voltage sag, and failure modes logged against temperature as a published dataset.

projects.title: Secure Robot-Fleet Updates
projects.description: Secure boot, TPM 2.0 measured boot, YubiKey-signed OTA updates, and automatic A/B rollback for the robot fleet - validated in a cold chamber and under power-cut chaos tests.

projects.title: Mini Airspace Deconfliction Manager
projects.description: ESP32 tracker beacons plus ArduPilot SITL simulated drones, dynamic 3D geofences, predicted-conflict alerts, and a human-in-the-loop override for every resolution.

projects.title: Multi-Domain Common Operating Picture
projects.description: The fusion layer tying every sensor build together: signed detections over MQTT/Zenoh, store-and-forward through dead links, a Kalman-filter tracker fusing air, water, and ground tracks, and a human making every decision.

projects.title: Arctic Domain Awareness Digital Twin
projects.description: Streaming pipeline fusing open ADS-B aircraft data, AIS ship tracking, and Sentinel-1 radar imagery over Canada's North, flagging dark vessels and route deviations. Relevant to NORAD modernization and Arctic sovereignty.

projects.title: DDIL-Proof DevOps
projects.description: CI/CD and telemetry that keep working through denied, degraded, intermittent, and limited links: store-and-forward, delta updates, signed artifacts, k3s edge nodes, chaos-tested with tc netem.

projects.title: Counter-Drone Sensor Fusion Simulator
projects.description: Synthetic radar, RF, acoustic, and camera tracks fused with Kalman filters, confidence scoring, and human-in-the-loop alert triage. Defensive, simulation only.

projects.title: Decision Black Box
projects.description: Tamper-evident audit layer for human-in-the-loop decisions: hash-chained signed append-only log, replay tool, and OPA policy-as-code checks.

projects.title: Zero-Trust Air-Gapped Software Supply Chain
projects.description: SBOM, sigstore signing, and reproducible builds moved across a simulated one-way transfer into an offline registry, mapped to Canadian Centre for Cyber Security guidance.

projects.title: Operation LENTUS-Style Disaster Response Drone Mapping
projects.description: Simulated drone flights mapping floods and wildfires, edge computer vision detecting affected areas, and a live situational-awareness map, with OR-Tools route optimization.

projects.title: Kubernetes Infrastructure
projects.description: Production-grade multi-node K8s cluster across 7 machines with VLAN segmentation, Calico CNI, MetalLB, Longhorn storage, and Prometheus + Grafana observability.

projects.title: TYF-AI - Self-Hosted Local AI Security Platform
projects.description: Hardened local AI inference: llama.cpp with CUDA, Open WebUI behind an authenticated Caddy proxy, per-model Firejail sandboxing, and GPU passthrough on Proxmox.

projects.title: Proxmox VE Zero-Trust Private Cloud
projects.description: 3-node Proxmox HA cluster with Ceph, VLAN segmentation, and zero public ingress via Cloudflare Tunnel with Tailscale fallback and automated ZFS snapshots.

projects.title: Data Sovereignty & Secure Media Stack
projects.description: Self-hosted Nextcloud + Immich on BTRFS external SSDs with multi-user ACL isolation and a 3-2-1 offsite backup pipeline to BorgBase and rsync.net.

projects.title: Chakor - Self-Hosted AI Workspace
projects.description: Open-source AI workspace you run yourself. Local and cloud models, web search, document chat, model compare, notes, and memory - all private on your hardware.

projects.title: Proxmox Homelab
projects.description: Full virtualization stack for testing servers, VMs, containers, and network configurations.

projects.title: Self-Hosted DNS

projects.title: Private Email Server

projects.title: Self-Hosted Cloud Storage
